initiatives.name: Science Based Targets and Net Zero Commitment
initiatives.summary: Howdens has committed to Science Based Targets initiative (SBTi) with approved targets to achieve a 42% reduction in Scope 1+2 emissions and 25% reduction in Scope 3 emissions by 2030 against a 2021 baseline, with an ultimate Net Zero goal of 90% emissions reduction.

timeline.latest_update: SBTi targets approved (date not specified, prior years)

evidence.title: Supplier engagement programme for Scope 3 emissions
evidence.summary: Howdens is collaborating with key suppliers to address Scope 3 emissions, which represent 95% of baseline total emissions. ESG objectives are now embedded in standard supplier terms of business with defined targets aligned to SBTi objectives, and the percentage of suppliers with approved SBTi plans grew from 9% to 15% year-on-year.
evidence.quote: ESG objectives are included in standard supplier terms of business. Defined targets in line with our SBTi objectives, and commitment to provide carbon reporting data.

evidence.title: SBTi Net Zero targets with 2030 interim goals
evidence.summary: Howdens has committed to Science Based Targets initiative (SBTi) with approved targets to achieve a 42% reduction in Scope 1+2 emissions and 25% reduction in Scope 3 emissions by 2030 against a 2021 baseline, with an ultimate Net Zero goal of 90% emissions reduction.
evidence.quote: 42% reduction in Scope 1+2 emissions 25% reduction in Scope 3 emissions SBTi targets: 2021–2030 (against a 2021 baseline)

initiatives.name: Distribution Fleet Decarbonisation Programme
initiatives.summary: Howdens is decarbonising its distribution fleet (which drove over 19 million miles in 2025) by increasing use of HVO biofuel (planned 40% increase in 2026), operating 15 LNG vehicles, and trialing electric vehicles in its XDC network with a third-party logistics partner.

evidence.title: Distribution fleet decarbonisation with HVO and LNG
evidence.summary: Howdens is decarbonising its distribution fleet (which drove over 19 million miles in 2025) by increasing use of HVO biofuel (planned 40% increase in 2026), operating 15 LNG vehicles, and trialing electric vehicles in its XDC network with a third-party logistics partner.
evidence.quote: We have increased our HVO usage in each of the last three years and plan to increase it by a further 40% in 2026.

evidence.title: XDC network electric vehicle trial
evidence.summary: Howdens is trialling electric vehicles in its XDC network (shorter-range deliveries operated by third-party logistics partners), now operating four electric vehicles as of end of 2025, as current EV technology lacks range for long-haul fleet replacement.
evidence.quote: We have engaged with one of our partners and between us we are now operating four electric vehicles at the end of 2025.

initiatives.name: France Depot Network Optimisation
initiatives.summary: Howdens is actively managing its French depot estate, including planned closures and relocations of depots, as part of efforts to improve existing depot sales performance. An impairment charge was recorded in relation to this optimisation plan.

evidence.title: France depot optimisation and relocations
evidence.summary: Howdens is actively managing its French depot estate, including planned closures and relocations of depots, as part of efforts to improve existing depot sales performance. An impairment charge was recorded in relation to this optimisation plan.
evidence.quote: There was also a charge of £6.1m in relation to the impairment of depot assets as part of our optimisation plans in France, where we are planning to relocate 6 depots over the next two years.

evidence.title: Compact depot format trial in France
evidence.summary: Howdens is trialling a more compact depot format at a new test site in Reims, France, which is under half the size of average depots with lower rental costs, incorporating the latest UK format innovations as part of international expansion strategy.
evidence.quote: We are also trialling a more compact version of our format, initially at a new test-depot in Reims to the west of Paris. At around 500 square metres, this version is under half the average size of the current depots has lower rental costs and the layout incorporates the latest UK format innovations.

initiatives.name: Howden Manufacturing Solar Installation
initiatives.summary: Howdens invested £3.5m in solar panels at its Howden manufacturing site, installing 7,000 PV panels covering 350,000ft2 of warehouse roof. The installation began generating power in 2025, producing 1.83GWh of electricity (12% of site consumption) with an expected payback within 5 years.
